newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end lower on technical sales.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end lower on technical sales.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures closed lower across the board on Tuesday, erasing Monday's price gains, as technical selling from local investors emerged, traders said.
Prices were 0.1 yen to 1.2 yen lower, with the benchmark May 1997 contract down 0.8 yen at 146.5 yen per kg.
Light technical selling from individual investors capped the topside of the market from the opening, following Monday's price gains, traders said.
"We expected light technical selling to emerge, and were not surprised," a trader said. Open interest of the spot month, which expires this Friday, was 9,016 lots as of December 16.
